node.title: L1 tangent confluent-packet packing
node.statement: For an exact shell of size a, let r_P=deg gcd(L_P,Q_P) be each member's tangent degree. Confluent packets give sum_{P:r_P>=j} binom(r_P,j)binom(a-j,k-2j)<=binom(n,j)binom(n-j,k-2j). In the balanced band, with omega=n-a and s=n-2a+k, the weighted intersection law gives the companion bound sum_{P:r_P>=j}binom(r_P,j)binom(omega,s-j)<=binom(n,j)binom(n-j,s-j). Its j=0 case is complement packing and consecutive tail-ceiling ratio is (w+j+1)/(r0-j), so positive j helps exactly above r0>w+1. These exact field-independent families avoid summing formal gcd owners but can remain exponential; no primitive flatness is asserted.
